item.title: retromo.de
item.description: A free, open source retrospective board for agile and remote teams: create a board, share the link and everyone can add, merge and vote on items live, without any login. It comes with drag and drop grouping, dot voting and a shared timer, is hosted in Germany and can be self-hosted with a single Docker image. The code is available on GitHub.

item.title: bewhere.app
item.description: A free web app for event staff scheduling. Plan which people work at which location and when, spot coverage gaps and share personal schedules with your festival, conference or venue team.
